name: African Cultural Alliance of North America (ACANA)
statusReason: Live, maintained site with recent activity (Africa Center development 2024); last 990 in 2023.
notes: About page states ACANA was established in 1999 by a group of African musicians; site references 'over 25 years.' Voffee Jabateh is the founder and longtime CEO/Executive Director (confirmed via WHYY, Inquirer, LinkedIn). IRS recognized 2001. No explicit incorporation date found.

name: Community of Compassion CDC
statusReason: Site is live and maintained (current Evening Resource Center hours, Thanksgiving program); last 990 in 2021.

eds.name: W. Lonnie Herndon
eds.title: President (Senior Pastor, Church of Christian Compassion)

notes: About page: CDC 'incorporated in 2001' as a 501(c)(3), an outgrowth of The Church of Christian Compassion (founded 1981). IRS recognized 2004. W. Lonnie Herndon has been senior pastor since 1994 and leads the CDC, formed as his community-service vision. Only the current leader is confirmable; no other named past EDs.

name: HACE
statusReason: Live, actively maintained site (current programs, leadership pages); HACE is an established, ongoing Philadelphia CDC.
notes: History page: HACE was started in 1982 by volunteers responding to the closing of a shopping mall in El Centro de Oro. Maria N. Gonzalez has been President since July 2013 (with HACE since 1996). Source batch had no EIN/990 data; org is clearly active. No explicit incorporation date found; no prior ED names surfaced within budget.

name: Inglis Housing Corporation
statusReason: Live site with open housing waitlists and current contact info; last 990 in 2023.
notes: Inglis Housing Corporation built its first housing community (Morris-Klein apartments) in 1975; site cites 'nearly 50 years' of accessible-housing development. IRS recognized 1985. Parent organization Inglis was founded in 1877 (distinct from the housing corporation). Heidi Bohn joined as Executive Director in 2023; Dyann Roth is President & CEO of parent Inglis. No prior IHC ED names found within budget.

name: Newbold CDC
statusReason: Site is maintained (2026 copyright, upcoming 2025 events); last 990 in 2023.
notes: Founding year not stated on site; estimated ~2010 because a 2019 article described Lidiak as in his 'ninth year' as CDC president. IRS recognized 2013. Tim Lidiak has led the organization since its start. foundedYear is an approximation from the tenure reference, not an explicit site statement.

name: Oxford Circle Christian Community Development Association (OCCCDA)
statusReason: Live, actively maintained site (current programs, open job postings, leadership pages); last 990 in 2023.
notes: Who-We-Are page: OCCCDA was 'fully incorporated as a 501(c)(3) in 2006,' growing out of Oxford Circle Mennonite Church. IRS recognized 2006. Source batch had currentExec null; the executive-staff page currently lists Katie Gard as Interim Executive Director (a permanent ED role is posted as open). Founder is the Mennonite church rather than an individual; no named prior ED found within budget.

name: South Kensington Community Partners
statusReason: Live site with a current 2025 year-end fundraiser; last 990 in 2023.
notes: Founded 1978 (PitchBook); formerly the Kensington South Neighborhood Advisory Committee. Site cites 'more than 30 years.' IRS recognized 1986 (possibly an incorporation/re-incorporation point). Leadership is ambiguous: the source batch and GuideStar name Eileen Divringi as President/principal officer, but the current website's About page lists Sarah Gearhart as Board President. Both recorded. This is a board-led org; no single executive director clearly named on the current site.

name: Wynnefield Overbrook Revitalization Corporation
statusReason: Live, maintained site (board/leadership pages current); last 990 in 2023.
notes: Founded 2005 by a community coalition led by then-Councilman (later Mayor) Michael Nutter, Congressman Robert Brady, residents, and Saint Joseph's University. IRS recognized 2007. Source batch had currentExec null; board-members page lists Gerald Murphy as current Executive Director (Bryan Fenstermaker is President & CEO of the affiliated City Ave District). A search surfaced Matthew Walker associated with the ED role earlier; exact years not confirmed, so not dated.
